> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-03

# Summary
Seven Word drafts for "Batch 2 (General Plumbing city hubs)", marked draft for review, not live, prepared by TAG on 2026-09-03. Each has SEO settings and page copy with H1/H2 levels, live hyperlinks, and "[Coupon block unchanged]" markers for the existing Elementor coupon section. The matching pre-change backup is `backup_batch2_general_2026-09-03` (see [Summit AZ - Backups Log](lib:brain-summit-az-backups-log)).

# Drafts
- 01 Tempe: H1 "Plumber in Tempe, AZ"; links to every Tempe service page; Tempe water hardness and HET toilet rebate; city leak guidance (service line on your property is the owner's job).
- 02 Queen Creek: water may come from the Town, EPCOR or another provider; everything past the meter is the owner's.
- 03 Phoenix, 04 Scottsdale, 05 Mesa (opens with the Mesa office address, 950 W. Birchwood Ave Suite 12), 06 Chandler (code and permits angle).
- 07 Parent: "Plumbing Services in the East Valley" listing all ten cities.

# Shared facts used
Arizona ROC #338366; licensed, bonded and insured; free estimate before any work; $20 off coupon block; phone (480) 447-7008.

# Caution
The Tempe draft still says "call our 24/7 line"; later work removed 24/7 claims to match Monday to Saturday hours. Check before reuse.
